newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Ceylon Grain reverses trend, gains early.
newsitem.headline: Ceylon Grain reverses trend, gains early.

text.p: Ceylon Grain Elevators Ltd gained 75 cents to 10.25 rupees on Monday after last week's dismal performance triggered by poor results, brokers said.
A total of about 270,000 shares were traded by 0445 GMT.
"The big seller who unloaded about nine million shares due to poor results has moved out. And world grain prices which hit the company badly, are easing," said a broker with a foreign joint venture.
